parameters.description:
`msg91-sms-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `msg91_sms` payload. The gateway composes the upstream MSG91 URL from your stored secrets, injects your credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a message through your own MSG91 SMS account by posting a native MSG91 payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's API credential
